logp.method_description: The water/n- octanol distribution coefficients were determined by the stir-flask method [40, 41]; water-saturated octanol and octanol-saturated water were prepared by shaking equal volumes of octanol and water for one week and allowing the mixture to separate into the respective phases. A UV-visible (UV-vis) calibration curve for each complex in octanol-saturated water in the 2–50 µM range was prepared. A mixture of 10 mL noctanol and 10 mL water (each saturated in the other) was stirred for 2 h at 37 °C, after adding the sample to be analyzed. The pH was maintained at pH 7.2 (5 mM TrizmaHCl: pH 7.2). Once equilibrium was reached, the organic and aqueous phases were separated and centrifuged. Finally, the concentration of drug in each phase was measured spectrophotometrically to determine values for D = [drug in octanol]/[drug in water]. Experiments were carried out three times [42].
